title: Relationship
description: A directed edge between two entities: source, target, relationship type, assignment state, scope, provenance, and validity (engineering plan section 7).

relationshipId.description: Stable ID for this specific edge, distinct from either endpoint's entityId.

assignmentState.description: Distinct from relationshipType so a PimEligible relationship's current state (e.g. Expired) can change without reclassifying the relationship itself.

scope.description: The scope this relationship is constrained to (e.g. an Azure resource/subscription/management-group path, an administrative-unit ID, or 'directory' for tenant-wide). Never absent -- use 'directory' explicitly rather than omitting the field.

startDateTime.description: Explicit null when the source system has no start boundary, never an absent property.

endDateTime.description: Explicit null when the relationship has no expiration.

isTransitive.description: Whether this edge represents a resolved transitive path (e.g. nested-group membership) rather than a direct assignment.
